summary: iter224 verified — Weekly Nudge Digest admin email + cron endpoint. 15/15 backend tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter224_nudge_digest.py: cron auth (missing/wrong/correct bearer, X-Webhook-Id echo, enqueued='nudge-digest'), compute_digest heuristic 3-nudge case (foundation=finished-updated-after-nudge, medical=not-finished-updated-before-nudge, educational=finished-drafts-null; totals 3/2/66.7% with human-readable by_topic keys), window boundaries (5d fresh + 20d old excluded, 8d included), empty window returns zeros AND send_nudge_digest with empty window returns recipients_sent=0 without calling email_service.send_nudge_digest, unknown topic filtered, ADMIN_EMAILS multi-recipient dispatch loop, single-admin failure does not abort loop, email body has 3 tiles + per-topic table + window range + '1 / 1' 'Finished / Sent' cells + subject '[SA CoParents] Nudge digest — 2 of 3 finished last week', plain-text bullets, crons.yml has both entries (guided-draft-nudge 0 15 * * 1 + nudge-digest 0 16 * * 1, {{BASE_URL}} templating, enabled:true), regression on /api/cron/guided-draft-nudge, fridge PDF, standard PDF. All seed data cleaned up (module-scoped fixture wipes guided_draft_nudges + resets portal_state.guided_drafts to null for parent1/parent2 before AND after run).
critical_code_review_comments: guided_draft_digest.compute_digest: correctly uses ISO-string sent_at parsing with Z→+00:00 fixup, per-user portal_state index built once (O(n) not O(n*m)), finished heuristic guards both draft-cleared and updated_ms>sent_ms within FOLLOW_UP_DAYS deadline. Defensive _TOPIC_LABELS whitelist prevents legacy/unknown topic contamination in by_topic. by_topic keys are label-only — no user_id leakage.

send_nudge_digest: skips email dispatch entirely when total_sent==0 (avoids weekly empty-inbox spam), per-admin try/except keeps the loop resilient to Resend transient failures, ADMIN_EMAILS parsed with comma-split + strip so whitespace-padded env values work.

cron_routes.nudge_digest_cron: identical shape to guided_draft_nudge_cron — hmac.compare_digest bearer verify, refuses when secret missing (not open-fails), BackgroundTasks enqueue, X-Webhook-Id → run_id echo. Clean.

email_service.send_nudge_digest: HTML-escapes user-visible topic labels + window strings, correct 'X of Y finished' subject formatting, 3-tile CSS grid + branded shell reused via _branded_html. Empty by_topic path shows 'No topic breakdown this week' colspan row.

crons.yml: both entries have consistent schema (name/description/cron/endpoint/method/enabled), 1-hour gap between 15:00 (nudge send) and 16:00 (digest) matches design intent so every included parent has a full 7-day follow-up window before digest counts them.
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / parent2@test.com (TestPass123!) used via direct Mongo user_id lookup; WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Per-test seeding of guided_draft_nudges + portal_state.guided_drafts for parent1/parent2. Module-scoped db_users fixture pre-cleans AND post-cleans (delete_many on guided_draft_nudges + set guided_drafts=null). Verified no stale data remains after run.

Combine with test_iter223_guided_nudge_and_fridge.py for full cron surface regression. Both parent1/parent2 portal_state.guided_drafts are reset to null at end of module — safe to leave.
